name: app-dark-yellow-habit-tracker-with-heatmap-grid-in-hand
title: Dark Habit Tracker with Yellow Heatmap
whatItIs: A hand holding a dark phone in front of a bright window, showing a habit tracker with a search bar, habit cards with stat trios and a grid of dim cells where completed days glow yellow, plus yellow Done and View All buttons and a tab bar.
whatItMeans: Yellow cells on dark grid make progress feel like a glowing pattern, and the silhouetted hand adds a cinematic feel.
techniques: Heatmap grid of small squares with yellow for done
Single yellow accent on black UI

vocabulary.definition: A grid of days where filled cells show completions.
Three key numbers in a row.
A hand silhouetted against a bright background.
